blocks.text: CEBU CITY — Inspired by the Premier Volleyball League’s 10th anniversary, fan favorite Jema Galanza led Creamline to a strong start in its title defense in the All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series before a record-setting 19,106 crowd at SM Seaside Arena here on Saturday. Galanza dazzled, dropping 16 points to power Creamline’s 25-18, 25-21, 25-18 sweep of Akari. Also celebrating her 10th year in the league, Galanza was nostalgic, recalling the success and strong bond of the Cool Smashers.
